sql.query: INSERT INTO tbl_contract_templates (tenantId,templateName,description,outputType,templateKey,subjectTemplate,bodyHtml,textTemplate,versionNumber,isActive,createdByUserId,modifiedByUserId) SELECT :tenantId,:templateName,NULLIF(:description,''),:outputType,NULLIF(TRIM(:templateKey),''),NULLIF(TRIM(:subjectTemplate),''),:bodyHtml,NULLIF(:textTemplate,''),1,:isActive,:userId,:userId2 FROM DUAL WHERE NULLIF(TRIM(:templateName2),'') IS NOT NULL AND NULLIF(TRIM(:bodyHtml2),'') IS NOT NULL AND :outputType2 IN ('contract','email','letter','report') AND (:outputType3<>'email' OR NULLIF(TRIM(:subjectTemplate2),'') IS NOT NULL) AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM tbl_user_tenant_roles utr INNER JOIN tbl_roles r ON r.id=utr.roleId AND r.isActive=1 INNER JOIN tbl_role_permissions rp ON rp.roleId=r.id INNER JOIN tbl_permissions p ON p.id=rp.permissionId AND p.isActive=1 WHERE utr.userId=:roleUser AND utr.tenantId=:tenantId2 AND utr.isActive=1 AND ((:outputType4='email' AND p.permissionCode='email.configure') OR (:outputType5<>'email' AND p.permissionCode='agreements.configure')))
SELECT id FROM tbl_contract_templates WHERE tenantId=:tenantId AND templateName=:templateName AND createdByUserId=:userId ORDER BY id DESC LIMIT 1

sql.query: INSERT INTO tbl_contract_template_clauses (tenantId,templateId,clauseId,clauseNameSnapshot,clauseHtmlSnapshot,sortOrder) SELECT c.tenantId,:templateId,c.id,c.clauseName,c.clauseHtml,FIND_IN_SET(c.id,:clauseIds) FROM tbl_contract_clauses c WHERE c.tenantId=:tenantId AND :outputType='contract' AND FIND_IN_SET(c.id,:clauseIds2)>0
